model_mechanism: Human-body twin development roadmap.
data_linkage: Discusses wearable data integration; no new paired longitudinal cohort appraised.
time_scope: Application-dependent development roadmap.
validation_scope: Conceptual synthesis; no new intervention outcome evaluated here.
claim_boundary: A roadmap does not establish a working whole-body twin or clinical effectiveness.

model_mechanism: Scoping review of health digital-twin applications and infrastructure.
data_linkage: Broad healthcare review; includes non-wearable hospital and imaging applications.
time_scope: No single implementation cadence.
validation_scope: Landscape and limitations, rather than a new wearable validation cohort.
claim_boundary: Only wearable-relevant concepts are mapped; the entire healthcare DT literature is not relabeled wearable evidence.

model_mechanism: Review and proposal for wearable-enabled healthcare twins.
data_linkage: Literature review and proposed integration, not newly collected patient data.
time_scope: Continuous monitoring is discussed, not a tested common update interval.
validation_scope: Review/conceptual evidence.
claim_boundary: Conceptual wearable integration does not establish an implemented autonomous twin.

model_mechanism: Functional architecture extending industrial digital-twin concepts to neuromusculoskeletal care.
data_linkage: Conceptual architecture with illustrative applications; not a new wearable outcome trial.
time_scope: Cadence depends on monitoring versus active-control use.
validation_scope: Framework and application examples.
claim_boundary: This is a proposed adaptation, not a healthcare standard or proof of intervention effectiveness.

model_mechanism: Longitudinal coronary CFD with reusable hemodynamic units and clustering.
data_linkage: Patient-specific angiographic geometry is combined with public continuous physiological streams; same-person pairing is not established here.
time_scope: Longitudinal reconstruction over six weeks; not demonstrated live clinical control.
validation_scope: Compared with explicit numerical simulations; long-horizon reconstruction.
claim_boundary: Numerical agreement and long-duration simulation do not establish prospective disease prediction or treatment benefit.

model_mechanism: Windkessel physics-informed neural network for cardiovascular parameter estimation.
data_linkage: Distinct ring and wrist bioimpedance protocols; wrist protocol includes 23 hypertensive participants.
time_scope: Protocol-based signal fitting; chronic autonomous deployment not established.
validation_scope: Human blood-pressure reconstruction/prediction was evaluated using separate ring and wrist bioimpedance protocols; recovery of cardiovascular model parameters was additionally tested on synthetic data. The synthetic parameter-recovery experiment is not direct human ground-truth validation of those internal parameters.
claim_boundary: Parameter fitting needs its own identifiability checks; ring and wrist evidence are retained separately.

model_mechanism: IMU/EMG-driven neuromusculoskeletal model for a wearable gait laboratory.
state_variables: Joint angles; Ground reaction forces; Ankle torque
data_linkage: Five IMUs and EMG with laboratory references; four post-stroke and nine healthy participants.
time_scope: Gait-cycle and walking-trial estimates.
validation_scope: Agreement with laboratory biomechanical references.
claim_boundary: Biomechanical agreement does not establish recovery benefit, and multi-location sensing is not wrist-only.

model_mechanism: Personalized foot shape and finite-element modeling with a domain-adapted LSTM surrogate.
data_linkage: Wearable inertial signals and personalized biomechanical modeling; 50-participant study.
time_scope: Running-related dynamic stress estimates.
validation_scope: Model and surrogate agreement under the reported running protocol.
claim_boundary: Predicted stress is not directly measured internal stress or prospectively validated fracture prevention.

model_mechanism: Radiology-derived conductivity model for electrode placement and bladder-volume simulation.
data_linkage: Anatomical conductivity simulations for a proposed body-worn monitoring design.
time_scope: Offline design optimization across simulated filling states.
validation_scope: In-silico electrode sensitivity and volume-estimation evaluation.
claim_boundary: The evaluated action is sensor design; no reduction in heart-failure admission or mortality is demonstrated.

model_mechanism: Personalized physiological glucose model identified from observed diabetes data, then replayed.
data_linkage: CGM, insulin and meal histories identify a personal replay model.
time_scope: Calibration followed by alternative-therapy replay.
validation_scope: Methodological simulation/reconstruction evaluation.
claim_boundary: Alternative trajectories remain model-dependent and do not by themselves identify a causal treatment effect.

model_mechanism: Replay simulators fitted to randomized crossover trial data.
state_variables: Time in range; Time below range; Glucose risk indices
action_space: Hybrid versus fully closed-loop insulin modality
data_linkage: 64 subject/modality pairs from a prior crossover trial.
time_scope: Retrospective trial replay.
validation_scope: Several glycemic metrics met equivalence; time below range failed equivalence.
claim_boundary: Reusing randomized data validates particular simulated outcomes; this paper is not a new randomized deployment of the replay tool.

model_mechanism: Glucoregulatory exercise digital twins for testing exercise decision support.
state_variables: Glucose; Time below range; Time in range
data_linkage: Clinical histories from 247 participants, including wrist heart rate, drive simulated comparisons.
time_scope: Exercise-session simulation.
validation_scope: Primary time-below-range outcome did not improve over guidelines; secondary time-in-range improved in simulation.
claim_boundary: Observed source data do not turn simulated policy outcomes into prospective intervention evidence.

model_mechanism: STUDIA digital-twin-enhanced bolus decision support.
data_linkage: 28-person, four-week open-label randomized study with CGM.
time_scope: Four-week intervention; model refresh cadence not appraised.
validation_scope: Trial reported improved time in range for the tested support system.
claim_boundary: Small short-term system-level trial; no isolated twin-component effect or long-term disease benefit established.

model_mechanism: Web interface for personal ReplayBG model creation and what-if replay.
data_linkage: User-supplied standardized diabetes histories; interface resource.
time_scope: Offline calibration and interactive scenario exploration.
validation_scope: Software/interface contribution; no clinical outcome validation inferred.
claim_boundary: Usability or access improvements do not validate the safety of therapy recommendations.

model_mechanism: Diet-condition-group-fine-tuned ANN plus particle swarm optimization and nurse review.
action_space: Daily dietary and activity SMS recommendations
data_linkage: Fitbit Inspire 2 steps, food logs, scale and glucose measures; 19-person ancillary randomized subset.
time_scope: Daily feedback and weekly retraining after baseline observation.
validation_scope: Exploratory trial: weight-loss signals, no significant glucose change; between-group significance needs careful reading.
claim_boundary: Methods specify group-conditioned fine-tuning, not a separately fitted model per person; lack of glucose significance is not equivalence or safety proof.

model_mechanism: DataSifter and synthetic-data generation for wearable-linked clinical data sharing.
data_linkage: Apple Watch and clinical data from 3,029 participants; synthetic records are not maintained individual dynamical models.
time_scope: Offline dataset synthesis.
validation_scope: Privacy–utility and re-identification-risk evaluations.
claim_boundary: Synthetic-twin terminology does not establish personal counterfactual dynamics or guaranteed anonymity.

model_mechanism: Person-specific XGBoost prediction of urine specific gravity with hypothetical input scenarios.
data_linkage: Three participants over 20 non-consecutive days; Garmin HR-derived measures and Chill+ GSR with intake and urine data.
time_scope: Three-hour windows shifted by 15 minutes for estimated trajectories.
validation_scope: Small multimodal feasibility study and illustrative what-if analyses.
claim_boundary: Input edits in an observational predictor do not establish beverage treatment effects; cumulative physiology is not modeled.

model_mechanism: ECG-derived respiration drives a CT-based lung-motion representation.
data_linkage: BIDMC and CapnoBase clinical signals; synchronized same-person ECG and 4D-CT validation is not established.
time_scope: Authors target real-time operation; publication-page appraisal emphasizes proof-of-concept scope.
validation_scope: Respiratory-rate evaluation; direct quantitative dynamic mesh validation remains limited.
claim_boundary: Wearable-oriented title does not establish a wrist-worn prospective deployment or validated personalized lung mechanics.

model_mechanism: Personalized diabetes simulations support human–machine co-adaptation.
state_variables: CGM glucose state and therapy parameters described by the prior co-adaptation card
action_space: Digital-twin replay, suggested parameter updates and user what-if exploration versus information-feedback periods.
data_linkage: CGM and automated insulin delivery study already catalogued in v1.1.
time_scope: Six-month study in the preserved v1.1 card; state-refresh and recalibration cadence not independently appraised in this pass.
validation_scope: 72 completed the six-month randomized-sequence study. Replay model and clinical package evaluated together. This is a cross-link to the preserved v1.1 annotation, not a fresh full-text review.
claim_boundary: System trial evidence is retained; isolated simulator benefit and transfer to wrist-only sensing are not established.

model_mechanism: Model Twin Randomization for within-person longitudinal effects.
state_variables: daily physical activity; sleep duration; past activity and sleep
action_space: Specified within-person physical-activity exposure contrasts; model-generated randomization.
data_linkage: Prior v1.1 source profile links Fitbit activity and sleep.
time_scope: See original study; no new timing appraisal.
validation_scope: Simulations and the authors’ longitudinal Fitbit step/sleep histories. This is a cross-link to the preserved v1.1 annotation, not a fresh full-text review.
claim_boundary: Model Twin Randomization is a causal-method connection, not evidence of a continuously synchronized digital-twin system.

model_mechanism: Walking-based identification as a possible identity-binding prerequisite.
action_space: Not applicable: no action is assigned in this resource.
data_linkage: Existing wrist fingerprinting record; conceptual connection only.
time_scope: See original study; no new timing appraisal.
validation_scope: IU and ZJU wrist accelerometry; within- and between-session identification tasks. This is a cross-link to the preserved v1.1 annotation, not a fresh full-text review.
claim_boundary: Identity discrimination alone does not establish latent physiological state, a causal simulator or treatment benefit.

model_mechanism: Micro-randomized intervention evidence as a simulator-validation connection.
state_variables: context and availability; suggestion assignment; 30-minute steps
action_space: Walking suggestion, anti-sedentary suggestion or no suggestion, randomized at repeated times.
data_linkage: Original HeartSteps record is retained; the new subpopulation simulator is separately watchlisted.
time_scope: See original study; no new timing appraisal.
validation_scope: Six-week MRT; 44 adults enrolled. Pooled suggestion comparison p=.06; type/time-specific effects differ. This is a cross-link to the preserved v1.1 annotation, not a fresh full-text review.
claim_boundary: The original intervention trial must not be counted as validation of a later digital twin.
